name: skeleton
title: Skeleton
description: A placeholder in the shape of what is loading: a #1A1A1A block with the brand corner, or a circle, that breathes between full and half opacity. Never a shimmer; still with reduced motion.
use_for: Holding the place of a creative card, a row or a chart while it loads, sized to the part it stands for so nothing moves when it lands.
never: A shimmer, a gradient sweep or a spectrum color
A layout that jumps when the content lands: size each block to its part
A skeleton for something that loads in under 300ms
source: Derived from the brand guidelines (no loading state in the brand assets): the neutral steps for the block, the brand corner
body:
When the picture it holds the place of arrives, pass it as `src` (with `alt`, `fit` and `position`): the block shows it, still,
in the same shape and corner. Without `src` the block carries `data-ds-placeholder`, so a page can be checked for
pictures still to fill.
